checks.name: Checked packets preserve46 signed post-census inspection hops; fewer stop before staging
Candidate range is exactly seven future dates and fixed weekdays; counters cannot widen
Missing checked-window selection blocks a create before transport
Empty or only-one free window stops without a visit and leaves ordinary disconnect cleanup available
Deterministic selection handles same-day and across-day slots, ordered by declared window order
Weekend-only openings do not override the predeclared weekday candidate constraint
Private extras, foreign source/revisions, malformed ranges and stale previews cannot bind
A bound pair cannot be selected again or replaced by an arbitrary create slot
Expired initial results block the physical create without reselection
Move requires a fresh owned-visit recheck and preserves the exact originally bound target
If the original move is no longer free, other free slots cannot silently replace it; exact visit remains cancellable
Changed business rules or current-visit revision block move preview before transport
The move snapshot expires independently of the original immutable selection
A lost preview response consumes its one attempt and cannot dispatch a create or restart selection
Caller mutation cannot rewrite the phase candidate range or bound source after validation
Failure to durably persist selected slots poisons the phase before any create
